title: Sparse satisfying assignment recovery for product-budget SAT
claims: SparseVariableSATSearch checks polynomial-time sparse satisfying assignment recovery from a decider correct on unit extensions.
ProductBudgetSATSearch checks sparse satisfying assignment recovery under the explicit polynomial wide-clause width-product bound.
ExactProductBudgetSAT independently checks P membership for the exact restricted decision language.

experiments.purpose: Bind the archived Lean modules and exact statements to the recorded local reference replay. The isolated experiment reports zero Lean invocations and can be complemented by replay with the pinned reference.
